nse:106830108.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830108.answer: Management guided in November 2025 (Q2 FY26 call) to FY26 revenue of ~₹12,500 crore with 15%+ average margins, noting lower margins on Coast Guard/ONGC/offshore orders. Q2 FY27 actuals show revenue dropping 16.5% YoY to ₹2,446.1 crore and EBITDA margin falling to 8.1%, below management's long-term 15% baseline guidance.

evidence.quote: We anticipate that this year, we will have revenue of approximately INR 12,500 crores or so
Thereafter, we will have may be a few months where we'll have only the Coast Guard and the MPV project as well as the offshore project where the margins are slightly less
But on an average, we can anticipate around 15% plus margins

nse:106837394.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106837394.answer: Management did not provide specific consolidated revenue or margin target numbers for Q2 FY27 on recent calls. In July 2026, Retail management explicitly noted they had "not put any margin target," aiming instead to double absolute EBITDA over three years. In October 2026, management noted H1 O2C performance was tracking an annualized EBITDA well over ₹80,000 crore.

evidence.quote: As far as our absolute EBITDA is going up, we are happy and that is why if you look at it, we have not put any margin target

So, when you look at the first half of FY 2027 performance, it is in our minds tracking annualized EBITDA well over Rs.80,000 Crores and I think this is something, it just tells you how the markets are

nse:106836523.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106836523.answer: Management did not give explicit numerical revenue or margin targets for Q2 FY27 in prior calls. In Q1 FY27, management noted percentage margin compression from expired PLI 1 and higher component prices passed through to selling prices. In Q2 FY27, Dixon reported revenue of ₹21,793.6 crore (+46.7% YoY) and EBITDA margin of 2.7% versus 3.8% YoY.

evidence.quote: Operating margin for the quarter reflected temporary compression on account of expiry of Mobile PLI 1 in March '26 and from increased selling prices driven by elevated input costs and broader supply chain inflationary factors
As increased input costs were passed through increase in selling prices, percentage margins look optically lower, mostly in mobile and IT hardware business

The pass-through of higher input cost through corresponding increasing in selling prices resulted in a lower reported margin percentage, particularly in mobile and IT hardware business, despite the recovery of increased cost through pricing adjustments

nse:106823051.question: What has management said about this on its recent calls?
nse:106823051.answer: Management did not discuss any distrust of intermediate CAs, root CA distrust, or key generation flaws. The closest discussion occurred in the Q4 FY26 call, where management stated that a Google policy change regarding multi-purpose and new root certificates had no impact because existing roots remained trusted while new roots were queued.

evidence.quote: Our new roots have been submitted some time back

So, nothing stops for us because our existing roots are already trusted on Google and we basically have a transition period where the existing roots will continue to work until the new roots are accepted by Google
So, there is really no impact as such

nse:106845578.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106845578.answer: In the Q1 FY27 call (July 2026), management reiterated guidance of 18% organic revenue growth, 25% PAT growth, ~25% EBITDA margin, and 16-16.5% PAT margin. The Q2 FY27 results matched these expectations, delivering 19.7% YoY revenue growth (₹207.0 crore), 26.6% YoY PAT growth (₹33.5 crore), a 24.0% EBITDA margin, and a 16.2% PAT margin.

evidence.quote: Finally, from an outlook perspective, our guidance remains unchanged from what we shared in the previous quarter, that is to achieve an organic growth of 18% and work towards achieving a PAT growth of 25%
With the result, overall, if you see, we may be able to maintain this EBITDA at 25% and the PAT around 16-16.5%

nse:106834360.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834360.answer: In July 2026 (Q1 FY27 call), management expected Q2 PRASK revenue growth of over 25% YoY. In November 2026 (Q2 FY27 call), management confirmed PRASK grew 31%, beating guidance. Revenue matched expectations, rising 25.9% YoY to ₹23,363.8 crore. Margins improved YoY with EBITDA margin rising to 8.2% (from 3.1%), though elevated fuel costs resulted in a ₹1,879.1 crore net loss.

evidence.quote: In terms of unit passenger revenue or PRASK for Q2FY27, with the current balanced demand￾supply equation and the higher fares holding up, we are expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year
Third, in this environment, we delivered a 31 percent increase in PRASK, which exceeded our guidance of more than 25 percent growth
In terms of profitability, EBITDAR came in at 25 billion rupees, at a margin of around 11 percent, compared to an EBITDAR of 11 billion rupees and a margin of 6 percent for the same period last year

nse:106830133.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106830133.answer: Management did not discuss raising money or issuing credit facilities in either call. In May 2025, management stated that the company holds Rs. 11,000 to Rs. 12,000 crores in cash and does not expect to take on debt for capex due to a healthy balance sheet, adding in October 2025 that it does not have much borrowings.

evidence.quote: As of now, we are having quite healthy Balance Sheet and we do not expect, but it will be based on the economic performance, we will see
I don't think it will be having any impact because we are not having any much borrowings, so it is almost the same

nse:106836275.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106836275.answer: In the August 2026 (Q1 FY27) and November 2026 (Q2 FY27) calls, management maintained full-year FY27 guidance of high single-digit top-line revenue growth, without providing specific numerical margin targets. The reported Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 11.9% YoY (₹16,198.7 crore) exceeded this full-year top-line expectation.

evidence.quote: Think we should stick on to the high single-digit growth for the full year
Regarding the guidance, I think we'll stick to what guidance we have given at the beginning of the year

nse:106834087.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834087.answer: In July 2026 (Q1 FY27 call), management guided for an 8–10% full-year volume growth band and maintained an 18–20% PBDIT margin guidance for FY27, noting Q2 is traditionally a lower-margin quarter due to product mix. The Q2 results saw standalone volume grow 6.4% and consolidated EBITDA margin drop to 15.6%, though H1 EBITDA margin remained within the 18–20% band.

evidence.quote: What we have seen is that quarter two has traditionally been a lower margin because of the mix of what we sell in quarter two overall. Given the fact that, we are taking a very strong drive in terms of premiumization, of how we want to go ahead from an overall mix. We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds

As we go ahead, possibly some of those indications will also look at whether price changes would happen in the second half, which could trigger demand even further. At the current stage, we are looking at the band of 8-10% for the full FY27
The great thing to look at is that the PBDIT margin growth at a half-year level is very good and the PBDIT margin is in the higher range of the overall band of what we have been speaking at 19.6%

nse:106829089.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829089.answer: In the Q1 FY27 call (August 2026), management declined to give specific overall revenue, EBITDA, or margin guidance. However, for Q2 FY27 (October 2026), Nazara reported record consolidated revenue of ₹803 crore (up 53% YoY) and an EBITDA margin of 14.9% (up 311 bps YoY), driven by strong gaming growth and consolidating Bluetile and BestPlay.

evidence.quote: At Nazara level, do we want to give any guidance in terms of revenue, EBITDA, or margin? Nitish Mittersain: Not at this point of time
Q2 was a record quarter for us: Revenue was INR 803 crores, our highest ever, up 53% year-on￾year
EBITDA grew 93% to INR 120 crores and EBITDA margin expanded 311 basis points to 14.9%

nse:106823393.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106823393.answer: Management did not give specific revenue or margin guidance for Q2 FY27, stating in July 2026 that they had "no guidance on that." They provided broader directional views, expecting food delivery margins to remain flattish over the next 1–2 years (October 2026) and quick commerce long-term Adjusted EBITDA margins to reach 6% (July 2026).

evidence.quote: Sorry, Swapnil, we don't want to comment on the quarter right now, no guidance on that
Directionally, we want to maintain margins broadly and reinvest in growth as much as it makes sense to continue to drive the growth upwards
It's hard to project or comment on margin trajectory every quarter but broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish

nse:106818661.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106818661.answer: In June 2026, management stated that a major $650 million deal would be revenue and margin accretive starting Q2 FY27. They also maintained an aspirational EBIT margin target of 16% to 17%. The 30.3% YoY revenue growth matched growth expectations, but Q2 EBIT margin came in lower at 15% due to wage hikes and deal amortization.

evidence.quote: And yes, it will be accretive - revenue & margin from Q2 onwards
Yeah, so from our perspective we have said we want to be in the 16 to 17 % range, that is our aspiration
EBIT margins for Q2 FY27 came in at 15%, 130 basis points declined year-on-year
